requirements.rationale: Observed 401 for unauthenticated request, 403 for non-host participant, and 200 for joined HOST in target session.
Observed 422 Unprocessable Entity when target session status is ENDED, and 200 when target session is LIVE.
Observed 400 Bad Request when Idempotency-Key is missing or whitespace, and 200 when present.
Observed 409 Conflict when expectedVersion does not match current stream version, and 200 when versions match.
Observed live stream version incremented from 1 to 2 in both response and persisted database record.
Observed 422 Unprocessable Entity when attempting to stop stream that is already ENDED.
Observed stream status transitioned to ENDED with ended_at timestamp populated, while session status remained LIVE.
Observed stage participants remaining in role STAGE_PARTICIPANT with microphone and camera enabled post-STOP.
Observed active content share remaining in ACTIVE status with NULL stopped_at post-STOP.
Observed pending stage request remaining in PENDING status with NULL decided_at post-STOP.
Observed active recording remaining in RECORDING status with NULL stopped_at post-STOP.

defects.description: Stopping a live stream does not demote STAGE_PARTICIPANT participants to VIEWER or disable their microphone and camera.
Stopping a live stream does not transition ACTIVE content shares to STOPPED with stoppedAt and incremented version.
Stopping a live stream does not transition PENDING stage requests to CANCELLED with decidedAt and incremented version.
Stopping a live stream does not transition STARTING or RECORDING recordings to STOPPED with stoppedAt and incremented version.

steps.text: The client submits the stop request.
steps.criticality_reason: Submitting the command to the backend is necessary to mutate stream state.

steps.text: The system returns the ended stream representation.
steps.criticality_reason: Backend must execute the stop mutation, persist ended status, and return HTTP 200 with the ended stream.
steps.rationale: Observed HTTP 200 response with status ENDED and endedAt, and verified live_streams database record updated with version increment.
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: Network response and database inspection together verify ended representation and persistence.

source_findings.finding: SessionsService.commandLiveStream executes UPDATE live_streams SET status = ENDED, version = version + 1, ended_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3).
source_findings.limits: SQL query in service does not verify successful transaction execution.
